pairs.subject: workflow-property-contracts
pairs.evidence: src/athena/contracts/harness.py:1 This package holds the seam types for an LLM companion (a harness that turns one prompt turn into channel events, tool manifests, ids, registry), not a training or inference workflow a third-party host drives by property name; a case-insensitive grep of src/athena/contracts and tests/contracts for epoch, trainer, inferer and decollate (and also evaluator, training, workflow) found no hits, and a repo-wide grep over git-tracked files for max_epochs, trainer, inferer and decollate found none either.

techniques.evidence: src/athena/contracts/harness.py:193 The harness here is an LLM turn engine. It has no training loop with forward/loss/backward stages to publish events between.

src/athena/contracts/manifest.py:220 A host-manifest check returns a list of problems, which looks like the property-check pattern, but what it checks is a tool catalog. It has no required or optional workflow property table.
